extracted.intended_audience: researchers and analysts working with USPTO office actions and patent prosecution data (data scientists, patent scholars, policy analysts)
extracted.subtask_description: A listing and description of the variables included in the 2017 USPTO Office Action Research Dataset files (office_actions, rejections, citations). Useful for researchers preparing, interpreting, or analyzing structured data about patent office actions, rejections, and citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: app_id
rubrics_metrics.description: Application number
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifier for the patent application. Present in office_actions, rejections, and citations data files. See dataset table for type/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: ifw_number
rubrics_metrics.description: Image File Wrapper (IFW) number of the Office action
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifier for the office action image wrapper. Present in office_actions, rejections, and citations data files. See dataset table for type/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: document_cd
rubrics_metrics.description: Office action document code
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Code identifying the specific office action document. Appears in the office_actions file. See dataset table for type/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: mail_dt
rubrics_metrics.description: Date Office action mailed from USPTO
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calendar date when the office action was mailed. Appears in the office_actions file. See dataset table for type/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: art_unit
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiner group art unit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner group (art unit) responsible for the application. Appears in the office_actions file. See dataset table for type/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: uspc_class
rubrics_metrics.description: Invention U.S. Classification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary U.S. patent classification for the invention. Appears in the office_actions file. See dataset table for type/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: uspc_subclass
rubrics_metrics.description: Invention U.S. Subclassification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subclassification within the U.S. patent classification. Appears in the office_actions file. See dataset table for type/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: header_missing
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if Office action is missing standard heading(s) or has no heading(s), 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary indicator for missing or nonstandard heading(s) in the office action. Appears in the office_actions file; useful for quality/format checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: fp_missing
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if Office action has no form paragraphs, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary indicator for absence of form paragraphs (standard PTO form paragraphs) in the office action. Appears in the office_actions file; can flag nonstandard/malformed actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: rejection_fp_mismatch
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if rejection(s) raised in action sentence(s) does not match form paragraph(s), 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary indicator that the substantive rejection(s) described in action sentences do not match the referenced form paragraphs; useful to detect inconsistencies between narrative and indexed form paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: closing_missing
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if Office action has no closing paragraph, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary indicator for missing closing paragraph in the office action document. Appears in the office_actions file; useful for completeness checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: rejection_101
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if 35 USC 101 rejection(s) raised, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator whether the action contains a subject-matter eligibility (101) rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: rejection_102
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if 35 USC 102 rejection(s) raised, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator whether the action contains a novelty (102) rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: rejection_103
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if 35 USC 103 rejection(s) raised, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator whether the action contains an obviousness (103) rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: rejection_112
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if 35 USC 112 rejection(s) raised, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator whether the action includes a written-description/enablement/claim-definiteness (112) rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: rejection_dp
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if non-statutory double patenting rejection(s) raised, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator for presence of a non-statutory double patenting rejection in the office action.

rubrics_metrics.name: objection
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if objection(s) raised, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator for procedural or formal objections raised in the office action (distinct from statutory rejections).

rubrics_metrics.name: allowed_claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if allowable claim(s) in Office action, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator that one or more claims were identified as allowable in the office action.

rubrics_metrics.name: cite102_gt1
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if more than 1 prior art citation referenced in 102 rejection, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag signaling whether more than one prior-art citation is referenced in 102 rejections; useful for measuring citation aggregation in novelty rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: cite103_gt3
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if more than 3 prior art citations referenced in 103 rejection, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag indicating whether a 103 rejection references more than three prior-art citations; useful for assessing complexity of obviousness rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: cite103_eq1
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if only 1 prior art citation referenced in 103 rejection, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag indicating a 103 rejection relying on exactly one prior-art citation.

rubrics_metrics.name: cite103_max
rubrics_metrics.description: Max number of prior art citations referenced in 103 rejection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric measure of the maximum number of prior-art citations referenced across 103 rejections in the office action; complements the binary thresholds above.

rubrics_metrics.name: signature_type
rubrics_metrics.description: Signature Type (0-Examiner; 1-Primary Examiner (PE); 2-Examiner + PE; 3-Examiner + Supervisory Patent Examiner (SPE); 4-Examiner + PE/SPE + Director)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Categorical code describing who signed the office action; useful for analyses of signatory patterns and supervisory involvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: action_type
rubrics_metrics.description: Type of action raised, indicated by section of 35 USC or category (double patenting, objections, or allowed claims)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in the rejections data file; describes the high-level statutory or categorical basis for the action/rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: action_subtype
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtype of action raised, indicated by section paragraph of 35 USC or keyword
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in the rejections data file; provides paragraph-level or keyword detail about the action (e.g., specific subsection or named subtype).

rubrics_metrics.name: claim_numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims in the application for which the action is raised
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists claim numbers affected by the action/rejection. Appears in the rejections data file; useful for claim-level analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: alice_in
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if Alice decision referenced in Office action text, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag indicating whether the Alice v. CLS Bank decision is cited in the office action text (relevance for 101/subject-matter eligibility analysis). Appears in rejections file.

rubrics_metrics.name: bilski_in
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if Bilski decision referenced in Office action text, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag for citation of Bilski decision in the office action; helpful for historical/policy analyses of eligibility jurisprudence. Appears in rejections file.

rubrics_metrics.name: mayo_in
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if Mayo decision referenced in Office action text, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag indicating whether Mayo v. Prometheus is referenced in the office action (relevance to subject-matter eligibility). Appears in rejections file.

rubrics_metrics.name: myriad_in
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if Myriad decision referenced in Office action text, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag for citation of the Myriad decision in the office action (relevance to biotechnology/genetic material eligibility issues). Appears in rejections file.

rubrics_metrics.name: citation_pat_pgpub_id
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent or pre-grant publication prior art cited
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifier for the cited patent or pre-grant publication in the citations data file; raw citation string as recorded.

rubrics_metrics.name: parsed
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent or pre-grant publication number parsed from citation_pat_pgpub_id
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parsed normalized publication/patent number extracted from the raw citation; appears in citations file and facilitates matching to bibliographic records.

rubrics_metrics.name: form892
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if citation listed on Form PTO-892, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary indicator that the citation appears on Form PTO-892 (applicant/attorney-submitted citation list). Appears in citations file.

rubrics_metrics.name: form1449
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if citation listed on Form PTO-1449, 0 otherwise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary indicator that the citation appears on Form PTO-1449 (examiner/office-submitted citation list). Appears in citations file.

rubrics_metrics.name: citation_in_oa
rubrics_metrics.description: Equals 1 if citation referenced in the action sentence of the Office action
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary flag that the citation is explicitly referenced in the action sentence (the substantive rejection language) of the office action; useful to distinguish citations merely listed from those relied upon in rejections.
